description: This Java test class verifies the behavior of the ModifyPolicySubstitutionStrategy, particularly focusing on its immutability and its handling of policy modification commands with and without placeholders.

classes.name: ModifyPolicySubstitutionStrategyTest
classes.description: A test suite for the ModifyPolicySubstitutionStrategy class, extending AbstractSubstitutionStrategyTestBase, focusing on immutability and placeholder substitution behavior.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Asserts that instances of ModifyPolicySubstitutionStrategy are immutable, using MutabilityAssert.

methods.name: applyReturnsTheSameCommandInstanceWhenNoPlaceholderIsSpecified
methods.description: Tests that when a policy modification command without placeholders is applied, the same command instance is returned.

methods.name: applyReturnsTheReplacedCommandInstanceWhenPlaceholderIsSpecified
methods.description: Tests that when a policy modification command with placeholders is applied, the placeholders are correctly replaced, returning a new command instance with substituted values.
